senses.en: Twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.

ex.en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
Extending public transport services beyond midnight would benefit shift workers who currently rely on expensive taxi journeys.

col: a midnight snack｜bữa ăn nhẹ lúc nửa đêm
tip: Dùng at midnight, không dùng in midnight.

senses.en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served
a long narrow piece of solid material
to officially prevent someone from entering or doing something

ex.en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
Sports centres should not bar residents from using essential facilities simply because they cannot afford membership fees.

col: a hotel bar｜quán bar khách sạn
a bar of chocolate｜một thanh sô-cô-la
bar someone from doing something｜cấm ai làm việc gì
tip: Nghĩa “cấm” dùng bar sb from doing; quá khứ là barred.

senses.zh: sự lựa chọn; quyền lựa chọn
senses.en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities

senses.zh: thứ có thể chọn; phạm vi lựa chọn
senses.en: something you can choose, or the range of available options
of especially good quality

ex.en: You have a choice between soup and salad.
Reliable public transport gives commuters a wider choice and reduces their dependence on private cars.

col: make a choice｜đưa ra lựa chọn
have no choice｜không có lựa chọn nào khác
a wide choice of｜nhiều lựa chọn
freedom of choice｜quyền tự do lựa chọn
tip: choice là danh từ, choose là động từ; chọn làm việc gì dùng choose to do.

senses.en: To go back, or give something back.

senses.zh: sự quay về; sự trở lại
senses.en: The act of coming or going back.
Money or benefits gained from an investment or activity.

ex.en: Please return these library books before you go away.
Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.

col: return to work｜quay lại làm việc
return on investment｜lợi nhuận đầu tư
tip: return đã có nghĩa “quay lại”, thường không thêm back.

senses.en: In the correct or suitable way.
Completely or to the degree that is needed.

ex.en: The kitchen door will not close properly in winter.
Public recycling schemes are more effective when residents understand how to sort household waste properly.

col: properly trained｜được đào tạo bài bản
properly equipped｜được trang bị đầy đủ
tip: properly bổ nghĩa cho hành động; proper bổ nghĩa cho danh từ.

senses.zh: hướng tây bắc; vùng tây bắc
senses.en: The direction between north and west, or an area's northwestern part.

senses.zh: thuộc tây bắc; từ tây bắc tới
senses.en: Located in the northwest, or coming from that direction.

senses.zh: về hướng tây bắc; ở phía tây bắc
senses.en: Towards or in the direction between north and west.

ex.en: Our cabin is in the northwest of the island.
Investment in rail networks could improve access to employment for communities in the northwest of the country.

col: in the northwest｜ở phía tây bắc
head northwest｜đi về hướng tây bắc
tip: Gió tây bắc thổi từ phía tây bắc; đi về phía tây bắc dùng head northwest.

senses.zh: người chạy bộ; vận động viên chạy
senses.en: a person who runs, especially for exercise or in races

ex.en: A runner in bright shoes passed us by the lake.
Urban parks provide runners with safer exercise spaces away from heavy traffic and polluted main roads.

col: long-distance runner｜vận động viên chạy cự ly dài
keen runner｜người đam mê chạy bộ
tip: Khi thêm -er vào run phải gấp đôi n; runner-up là người về nhì.

senses.en: Meat from a pig, used as food.

ex.en: We cooked the pork slowly with apples and onions.
Clear food labelling helps consumers identify products containing pork and make choices that suit their dietary requirements.

tip: pork là danh từ không đếm được chỉ thịt; con lợn còn sống là pig.

senses.en: Plays and the art of writing or performing them.

senses.zh: sự kiện kịch tính; cảnh gay cấn
senses.en: An exciting or emotional event or situation.

ex.en: Our drama group rehearses in the hall every Thursday.
Teaching drama in schools can develop students' confidence and encourage them to consider different perspectives.

tip: Nghệ thuật kịch là danh từ không đếm được; “một vở kịch” nói là a drama.

senses.zh: sự ngạc nhiên; điều bất ngờ
senses.en: An unexpected event, or the feeling it causes.
To make someone feel amazed by something unexpected.

ex.en: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.

col: a pleasant surprise｜một bất ngờ thú vị
to someone's surprise｜trước sự ngạc nhiên của ai
take someone by surprise｜làm ai trở tay không kịp
a surprise visit｜chuyến thăm bất ngờ
tip: Người cảm thấy ngạc nhiên dùng surprised; sự vật gây ngạc nhiên dùng surprising.

senses.zh: trường hợp; ví dụ; ca bệnh
senses.en: A particular situation or example, including an instance of illness.
A container that holds or protects something.
A legal matter or arguments supporting a particular position.

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains later.
In many cases, investing in preventive healthcare is more cost-effective than treating diseases after they develop.

col: in some cases｜trong một số trường hợp
in case of emergency｜trong trường hợp khẩn cấp
a strong case for｜lập luận mạnh mẽ cho
tip: in case đi với mệnh đề; in case of đi với danh từ.

senses.en: a small creature with eight legs, often making webs

ex.en: A tiny spider built a web beside our window.
Although many people fear spiders, these creatures help control insect populations in gardens and agricultural environments.

tip: Nhện có tám chân nên không phải côn trùng sáu chân.

senses.en: A spice used to give food a hot flavour.
A hollow vegetable that can taste sweet or hot.
To cover or fill something with many small things.

ex.en: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
Farmers can grow peppers in greenhouses to maintain a reliable food supply throughout the year.

col: pepper something with examples｜dùng nhiều ví dụ trong việc gì
tip: Bột tiêu không đếm được; một quả ớt chuông có thể nói a pepper.

senses.en: to let someone do something

senses.zh: làm cho có thể; chấp nhận
senses.en: to make something possible
to provide enough time or resources for something

ex.en: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.

col: allow someone to do something｜cho phép ai làm gì
allow enough time｜dành đủ thời gian
allow for delays｜tính đến khả năng chậm trễ
tip: Dùng allow sb to do; khi không có tân ngữ có thể dùng allow doing.

senses.en: staying outdoors in a tent, usually for a holiday

ex.en: We are going camping by the river this weekend.
Camping can encourage greater appreciation of nature, provided visitors avoid disturbing wildlife and take their rubbish home.

tip: camping chỉ hoạt động nên không đếm được; đi cắm trại nói là go camping.

senses.en: A small insect that lives in organised groups.

ex.en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
Ants contribute to healthy ecosystems by moving seeds and improving the structure of soil.

tip: ant là danh từ đếm được; “một con kiến” nói là an ant.

senses.en: to move something higher or increase its amount or level
to collect money for a particular purpose
to care for children or animals as they grow

ex.en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.

tip: raise là ngoại động từ, cần tân ngữ; rise chỉ tự nó tăng lên.

senses.en: Put something somewhere, or establish a condition, value, or rule.
A group of related things that belong together.
Fixed or arranged in advance.

ex.en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.

col: a set of tools｜một bộ dụng cụ
a set time｜thời gian cố định
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là set; dạng V-ing là setting.

senses.en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food.
Food given to farm animals.
A regularly updated stream of online content.

ex.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.

col: feed the animals｜cho động vật ăn
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là fed; feed on nghĩa là sống bằng, ăn.

senses.en: A flat, round cake made by frying a liquid mixture

ex.en: He flipped the pancake and reached for the honey.
Preparing pancakes in cooking classes allows students to practise measuring ingredients and using kitchen equipment safely.

col: a stack of pancakes｜một chồng bánh kếp
tip: Kiểu Anh thường mỏng hơn, kiểu Mỹ thường dày và xốp hơn.

senses.en: Not including a particular person or thing.
Used to introduce a fact limiting what was just said.

ex.en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
The proposed transport policy benefits most residents, except those living in remote rural communities.

tip: except loại trừ; besides có nghĩa là ngoài ra còn bao gồm.

senses.en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing.
Not moving.
Despite what has just been said.

ex.en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.

tip: Khi mang nghĩa “vẫn”, still thường đứng trước động từ thường và sau động từ be.

senses.en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale.
Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air.
New or different from what existed or was used before.

ex.en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.

col: a fresh start｜một khởi đầu mới
tip: fresh water là nước ngọt; fresh air là không khí trong lành.

senses.en: A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence or list.

ex.en: I added a comma to make the sentence clearer.
A misplaced comma can change the meaning of a sentence and confuse readers of academic writing.

col: a misplaced comma｜dấu phẩy đặt sai chỗ
separate items with commas｜ngăn cách các mục bằng dấu phẩy
tip: comma là dấu phẩy; dấu chấm câu là full stop (Anh) hoặc period (Mỹ).

senses.en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used.

senses.zh: phá hoại hoàn toàn; làm mất đi
senses.en: To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.

ex.en: A sudden storm destroyed the old shed behind our house.
Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.

col: destroy habitats｜phá hủy môi trường sống
tip: destroy mạnh hơn damage, thường chỉ sự phá hủy hoàn toàn.

senses.en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.

ex.en: Our professor brought ancient coins to class today.
The professor encouraged students to evaluate different sources before drawing conclusions about climate policy.

col: professor of economics｜giáo sư kinh tế học
tip: Ở Anh thường chỉ chức danh cấp cao; ở Mỹ cũng dùng chung cho giảng viên đại học.

senses.en: one of two earpieces worn over the ears for listening

ex.en: I wear headphones so my music won't disturb anyone.
Students using headphones in shared study spaces should keep the volume low to protect their hearing.

col: a pair of headphones｜một chiếc tai nghe
tip: Hằng ngày thường dùng số nhiều headphones; “một chiếc” nói là a pair of headphones.

senses.zh: cải thiện; nâng cao; tốt lên
senses.en: To become better or make something better.

ex.en: My cooking has improved since I started practising daily.
Investing in teacher training can improve educational outcomes, especially in schools serving disadvantaged communities.

col: improve access to｜cải thiện khả năng tiếp cận
improve living standards｜nâng cao mức sống
tip: Có thể là ngoại động từ hoặc nội động từ: improve skills; skills improve.

senses.en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric.
Fabric or thread made from cotton fibres.

ex.en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
Cotton production can place considerable pressure on water supplies, particularly in regions with limited rainfall.

tip: Thường không đếm được; trong cotton shirt, cotton đóng vai trò bổ nghĩa cho danh từ.

senses.zh: mối quan hệ; quan hệ tình cảm
senses.en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other.

senses.zh: mối liên hệ; sự liên quan
senses.en: A connection between things or the way they affect each other.

ex.en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.

col: build a relationship｜xây dựng mối quan hệ
a close relationship｜mối quan hệ thân thiết
the relationship between A and B｜mối quan hệ giữa A và B
tip: Quan hệ với ai dùng with; quan hệ giữa hai bên dùng between.

senses.en: With something added to an amount or group.
An advantage or positive feature.
Greater than zero, especially when describing temperatures.

ex.en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.

col: a big plus｜một điểm cộng lớn
plus ten degrees｜trên không mười độ
tip: Khi plus là danh từ chỉ ưu điểm thì đếm được, như a big plus.

senses.en: Music with strong rhythms and often freely invented melodies.

ex.en: We listened to jazz while cooking dinner together.
Community jazz festivals can attract visitors while giving local musicians valuable opportunities to perform.

tip: Khi chỉ thể loại nhạc thường không đếm được, không dùng a.

senses.en: A unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

ex.en: We bought a kilogramme of apples at the market.
Producing a kilogramme of beef generally requires more water than producing the same weight of vegetables.

col: a kilogramme of rice｜một ki-lô-gam gạo
tip: Đây là biến thể chính tả của tiếng Anh Anh; kilogram phổ biến hơn, ký hiệu kg không thêm s.

senses.en: a round vegetable with layers and a strong smell

ex.en: Chopping this onion is making my eyes water again.
Growing onions and other vegetables locally can shorten supply chains and provide communities with fresher produce.

col: chop an onion｜thái nhỏ hành tây
tip: Từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm nên số ít đi với an: an onion.

senses.en: severe weather with strong winds and rain, snow, or thunder
to move somewhere angrily and forcefully

senses.zh: làn sóng phản ứng; cơn bão dư luận
senses.en: a sudden wave of strong public anger or criticism

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.

col: a storm of protest｜làn sóng phản đối
storm out of the room｜đùng đùng bỏ ra khỏi phòng
tip: storm out nghĩa là giận dữ bỏ đi, không phải cơn bão di chuyển ra ngoài.

senses.en: An area around people's homes within a town or city.
The people living in a particular local area.

ex.en: A small bakery has just opened in our neighbourhood.
Investing in neighbourhood parks can improve residents' health while creating opportunities for people to meet and socialise.

col: a quiet neighbourhood｜khu phố yên tĩnh
tip: Kiểu Anh viết neighbourhood, kiểu Mỹ viết neighborhood.

senses.en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces.
Having little body fat or flesh.
To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.

ex.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.

col: thin out｜tỉa thưa; trở nên thưa dần
tip: Khi tả vóc dáng, thin không phải lúc nào cũng khen; slim thường mang ý khen.

senses.en: To produce words or images on paper using a machine
Letters and words produced on paper by printing
A mark left by something pressed against a surface

ex.en: Could you print two copies of this recipe?
Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.

col: small print｜chữ nhỏ; điều khoản chi tiết
in print｜đang được xuất bản và còn bán
out of print｜đã hết bản in
tip: print out là in ra; out of print nghĩa là sách đã hết bản in.

senses.en: agreement allowing someone to do something

ex.en: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.

col: permission to do something｜sự cho phép làm việc gì
tip: Thường không đếm được; nói give permission, không thêm a.

senses.en: feeling tired and ready to sleep
quiet and having very little activity

ex.en: I felt sleepy after lunch and took a short nap.
Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.

tip: sleepy là buồn ngủ; asleep là đã ngủ rồi.

senses.en: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell.
Feeling that you might vomit.
Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.

col: feel sick｜thấy buồn nôn; thấy không khỏe
call in sick｜gọi điện xin nghỉ ốm
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh, be sick thường nghĩa là nôn, feel sick thường nghĩa là buồn nôn.

senses.en: not curved or bent
directly, without turning or stopping
honest and clear rather than hiding the truth

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.

col: go straight ahead｜đi thẳng về phía trước
a straight answer｜câu trả lời thẳng thắn
tip: straight tự nó có thể làm trạng từ, không cần thêm -ly.

senses.en: Work done to keep a home clean and tidy.

ex.en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.

col: share the housework｜chia sẻ việc nhà
tip: Không đếm được, không nói a housework; làm việc nhà dùng do.

senses.en: a word naming a person, place, thing, quality, or idea

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to circle every noun.
Understanding whether a noun is countable helps language learners choose appropriate articles and express quantities accurately in academic writing.

col: uncountable noun｜danh từ không đếm được
tip: Danh từ không chỉ là vật cụ thể mà còn có thể là khái niệm trừu tượng như advice.

senses.en: a portable computer with a flat touchscreen
a small solid dose of medicine swallowed whole
a flat stone or metal slab bearing an inscription

ex.en: I use my tablet to watch cooking videos.
Providing every student with a tablet may improve access to resources, but teachers still need suitable training.

col: take a tablet｜uống một viên thuốc
tip: tablet vừa là máy tính bảng vừa là viên thuốc, cần dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

senses.en: pain in a tooth or the surrounding area

ex.en: My toothache kept me awake for most of the night.
Affordable dental services allow people with toothache to seek treatment before more serious problems develop.

tip: Tiếng Anh Anh thường nói have toothache, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường nói have a toothache.

senses.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.

col: take someone's temperature｜đo nhiệt độ cho ai
tip: have a temperature thường nghĩa là bị sốt, không chỉ là có thân nhiệt.

senses.en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another.

senses.zh: mối nguy hại; kẻ thù lớn
senses.en: Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.

ex.en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.

col: bitter enemy｜kẻ thù không đội trời chung
tip: enemy là kẻ thù; đối thủ trong thi đấu thường dùng opponent.

senses.en: The sport of travelling down snowy slopes on one board.

ex.en: I tried snowboarding yesterday and landed in soft snow.
Snowboarding lessons should include safety training so that beginners can share mountain slopes responsibly.

col: snowboarding lessons｜các lớp học trượt ván tuyết
snowboarding equipment｜dụng cụ trượt ván tuyết
tip: Trong snowboarding hai chân cùng đứng trên một tấm ván, khác với trượt tuyết hai ván.

senses.en: to move over ice or ground wearing special wheeled or bladed shoes
a boot with a blade or wheels for moving smoothly

ex.en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.

col: a pair of skates｜một đôi giày trượt
tip: Giày thường dùng số nhiều skates; go skating nghĩa là đi trượt băng hoặc patin.

senses.en: an idea or detail expressed in speech or writing
the sharp, narrow end of something
show a direction or object with a finger or tool

ex.en: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.

col: point of view｜quan điểm; cách nhìn
point at something｜chỉ vào vật gì
tip: make a point là nêu ý kiến; point at là chỉ vào.

senses.en: not any of the people or things being considered
not at all, used before certain comparative expressions

ex.en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.

col: none at all｜hoàn toàn không có
none the wiser｜vẫn chẳng hiểu hơn
none other than｜chính là; không ai khác ngoài
tip: none có thể đứng một mình; muốn bổ nghĩa cho danh từ dùng no, như no books.

senses.en: The vast salt water covering much of Earth's surface.

ex.en: We watched the sun rise over the ocean.
Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.

tip: ocean thường rộng lớn hơn sea; tên riêng thường có the.

senses.en: Enjoyable or comfortable to experience.
Friendly and polite towards other people.

ex.en: We enjoyed a pleasant walk beside the river.
Public gardens provide pleasant spaces where residents can exercise, socialise, and escape the pressures of urban life.

col: a pleasant surprise｜một bất ngờ thú vị
a pleasant atmosphere｜bầu không khí dễ chịu
tip: pleasant mô tả sự vật dễ chịu; pleased mô tả người cảm thấy vui.

senses.en: To take and use something with permission, then return it.
To use an idea or word from another source.

ex.en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?
Many languages borrow words from others as international trade and cultural exchange bring communities closer.

col: borrow from｜mượn từ; vay mượn từ
tip: borrow là mượn vào, lend là cho mượn; mượn của ai dùng from.

senses.en: To appear to be a certain way.

ex.en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.

col: seem likely｜có vẻ có khả năng
tip: Thường dùng seem + tính từ hoặc seem to do, không mang nghĩa “giả vờ”.

senses.en: A flat board used to support or store things.
A broad, relatively flat area of rock or seabed.

ex.en: Put the clean cups on the shelf above the sink.
Placing healthy snacks on shelves at eye level may encourage shoppers to make more nutritious food choices.

tip: Số nhiều là shelves; shelf life là hạn sử dụng.

senses.en: The language spoken in Portugal, Brazil, and several other countries

senses.zh: thuộc Bồ Đào Nha; thuộc tiếng Bồ Đào Nha
senses.en: Relating to Portugal, its people, or their language
The people of Portugal, considered as a group

ex.en: My neighbour speaks Portuguese with her family at home.
Learning Portuguese can help students access a wider range of literature and international career opportunities.

col: speak Portuguese｜nói tiếng Bồ Đào Nha
European Portuguese｜tiếng Bồ Đào Nha châu Âu
Portuguese culture｜văn hóa Bồ Đào Nha
tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu; chỉ một người Bồ Đào Nha thì dùng a Portuguese person.

senses.en: Despite what has happened or what someone has said.
Used to add a reason or return to the main subject.

ex.en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.

col: do it anyway｜vẫn làm dù sao
thanks anyway｜dù sao cũng cảm ơn
tip: anyway là trạng từ; any way nghĩa là bất kỳ cách nào.

senses.en: A cosmetic applied to lips to give them colour.

ex.en: She put on red lipstick before leaving the house.
Cosmetics companies are developing refillable lipstick containers to reduce packaging waste and respond to environmental concerns.

col: a tube of lipstick｜một thỏi son
tip: Nghĩa chất liệu không đếm được; “một thỏi son” nói là a tube of lipstick.

senses.zh: bếp nấu; dụng cụ nấu ăn
senses.en: an appliance used for cooking food

ex.en: The soup is bubbling in a pot on the cooker.
Replacing an inefficient cooker with a modern appliance can reduce household energy consumption over time.

tip: Tiếng Anh Anh dùng cooker cho bếp nấu, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng stove; đầu bếp là cook.

senses.en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.

ex.en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.

col: an item of clothing｜một món quần áo
tip: clothing không đếm được; “một món quần áo” nói là an item of clothing.

senses.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is

senses.zh: độ cao so với mặt đất; độ cao so với mực nước biển
senses.en: the distance of something above the ground or sea

senses.zh: đỉnh cao; thời kỳ đỉnh điểm
senses.en: the time when something is strongest or most successful

ex.en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.

col: at a height of｜ở độ cao
a fear of heights｜chứng sợ độ cao
at the height of｜vào thời kỳ đỉnh cao của
tip: height là danh từ; tả người cao dùng tall, tả vật cao có thể dùng high.

senses.en: To cook food in an oven using dry heat.

ex.en: I baked some bread while the children set the table.
Schools can teach children to bake simple foods as part of practical lessons about nutrition and independence.

tip: bake thường dùng cho bánh mì và bánh ngọt; nướng thịt thường dùng roast.

senses.zh: người làm vườn; người yêu thích làm vườn
senses.en: someone who grows and cares for plants in a garden

ex.en: The gardener planted bright flowers along our front path.
Community gardeners can improve urban biodiversity by growing native plants that provide food and shelter for wildlife.

col: a professional gardener｜người làm vườn chuyên nghiệp
a keen gardener｜người đam mê làm vườn
an experienced gardener｜người làm vườn giàu kinh nghiệm
tip: Có thể chỉ người làm vườn chuyên nghiệp hoặc người yêu thích trồng hoa, rau ở nhà.

senses.en: Almost, but not completely or exactly.

ex.en: I nearly missed the bus because I overslept.
Nearly half of the surveyed residents supported expanding public transport rather than building additional roads.

col: not nearly enough｜còn lâu mới đủ
tip: nearly nghĩa là chỉ thiếu một chút; not nearly nghĩa là còn xa mới đạt.

senses.en: a loose top and trousers worn for sleeping

ex.en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.

col: a pair of pyjamas｜một bộ đồ ngủ
tip: Dùng ở dạng số nhiều; “một bộ” nói là a pair of; tiếng Anh Mỹ viết pajamas.

senses.en: A period of one hundred years.

ex.en: This bridge was built more than a century ago.
Over the past century, improvements in sanitation have contributed significantly to longer life expectancy worldwide.

col: the twentieth century｜thế kỷ hai mươi
over a century ago｜hơn một thế kỷ trước
the turn of the century｜thời điểm giao thừa của thế kỷ
tip: Số thứ tự của thế kỷ lớn hơn hai chữ số đầu của năm một đơn vị: 1901 đến 2000 là thế kỷ 20.

senses.en: the points gained in a game, test, or competition
to gain points in a game, test, or competition
music written for a film or the written music itself

ex.en: My score improved after a week of practice.
Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.

tip: score có thể là danh từ hoặc động từ; score a goal nghĩa là ghi bàn.

senses.zh: đạp xe; môn đua xe đạp
senses.en: The activity of riding a bicycle for transport or exercise.

ex.en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.

col: cycling helmet｜mũ bảo hiểm xe đạp
cycling infrastructure｜hạ tầng cho xe đạp
tip: Khi chỉ hoạt động này thường không đếm được; hay nói go cycling.

senses.zh: hành động; cư xử; đóng vai
senses.en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role.
Something that someone does.
A law formally approved by a legislative body.

ex.en: We must act quickly before the kitchen sink overflows.
Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.

col: act as｜đóng vai trò; làm nhiệm vụ
an act of kindness｜một hành động tử tế
pass an act｜thông qua một đạo luật
tip: act as nghĩa là đóng vai trò; act còn có thể là một hồi của vở kịch.

senses.en: One of the main yearly periods with particular weather conditions.

senses.zh: mùa cao điểm; mùa giải; thời kỳ hoạt động
senses.en: A period when a particular activity or event usually happens.
Add salt, herbs, or spices to improve food's flavour.

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.

tip: Làm động từ, season nghĩa là nêm gia vị, hay dùng season food with….

senses.en: To give an answer without having enough information to be certain.
An answer or opinion given without being certain.
To think something is probably true, without being completely sure.

ex.en: Can you guess what is inside this little box?
Without reliable data, researchers can only guess how changes in transport costs will affect household spending.

col: an educated guess｜phỏng đoán có căn cứ
tip: I guess mang tính khẩu ngữ, nghĩa là “tôi nghĩ, chắc là”, thể hiện sự không chắc chắn.

senses.zh: thời gian biểu; lịch trình; thời khóa biểu
senses.en: A schedule showing when lessons, journeys, or other events happen.
To arrange when an event or activity will happen.

ex.en: I checked the timetable before leaving for the station.
A flexible school timetable can help students balance academic subjects with physical activity and creative learning.

col: school timetable｜thời khóa biểu của trường
a revised timetable｜thời gian biểu đã điều chỉnh
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh hay dùng timetable; tiếng Anh Mỹ hay dùng schedule.

senses.en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.

ex.en: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.

col: a royal princess｜công chúa hoàng gia
a fairy-tale princess｜công chúa trong truyện cổ tích
tip: Có thể chỉ con gái của vua hoặc vợ của hoàng tử.

senses.en: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

ex.en: Add one gramme of salt to the soup.
Even a single gramme of certain pollutants can harm aquatic life when released into a small pond.

col: a gramme of salt｜một gam muối
tip: gramme là biến thể của tiếng Anh Anh; gram phổ biến hơn, ký hiệu đơn vị là g.

senses.en: having the skill, opportunity, or means to do something
skilled and effective at doing things

ex.en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.

col: an able leader｜một nhà lãnh đạo giỏi
an able student｜một học sinh có năng lực
tip: Muốn nói có thể làm việc gì dùng be able to do, không dùng able doing.

senses.en: Meat from a pig's leg, preserved by salting or smoking.

ex.en: I put some ham and cheese in my sandwich.
Processed meats such as ham often contain substantial amounts of salt, which consumers should consider when planning meals.

col: a slice of ham｜một lát giăm bông
tip: Thịt giăm bông thường không đếm được; “một lát” nói là a slice of ham.

senses.en: waste material that people throw away

senses.zh: lời vô nghĩa; thứ vô giá trị
senses.en: something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality

ex.en: Please take the garbage out before it starts smelling.
Cities can reduce the amount of garbage sent to landfill by improving recycling facilities and public awareness.

col: take out the garbage｜đem rác ra ngoài
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; phổ biến trong tiếng Anh Mỹ, tiếng Anh Anh hay dùng rubbish.

senses.en: a person paid to clean buildings or rooms

senses.zh: chất tẩy rửa; máy làm sạch
senses.en: a substance or device used to remove dirt

senses.zh: sạch hơn; ít ô nhiễm hơn
senses.en: having less dirt or causing less pollution

ex.en: The cleaner emptied the bins before the office opened.
Hospitals should provide every cleaner with suitable protective equipment and training to reduce infection risks.

col: office cleaner｜nhân viên dọn văn phòng
window cleaner｜người lau cửa sổ; chất lau kính
household cleaner｜chất tẩy rửa gia dụng
tip: a cleaner thường chỉ người dọn vệ sinh; cleaner cũng là dạng so sánh hơn của clean.

senses.en: A computer designed for use by one person.

ex.en: My PC takes ages to start on cold mornings.
Providing each student with a PC may improve access to digital resources, but requires substantial funding.

col: desktop PC｜máy tính cá nhân để bàn
use a PC｜dùng máy tính cá nhân
PC software｜phần mềm cho máy tính cá nhân
tip: PC là viết tắt của personal computer; số nhiều là PCs.

senses.en: a qualification awarded after completing a university course
the amount or level of something
a unit used to measure temperature or angles

ex.en: My cousin earned a degree in engineering last summer.
Although a university degree can improve employment prospects, practical experience remains highly valuable in many industries.

col: a degree in economics｜bằng về kinh tế học
to some degree｜ở một mức độ nào đó
tip: Bằng cấp theo chuyên ngành dùng a degree in; nghĩa “mức độ” hay gặp trong to some degree.

senses.en: A book used to study a particular subject.
Showing exactly how something usually happens or should be done.

ex.en: I left my science textbook on the kitchen table.
Digital textbooks can reduce school expenses, although some students find printed materials easier to study.

col: school textbook｜sách giáo khoa của trường
textbook publisher｜nhà xuất bản sách giáo khoa
tip: Làm tính từ nghĩa là điển hình hoặc chuẩn mực, như textbook example.

senses.en: animal skin treated for making clothes, bags, and other goods

ex.en: Her old leather bag still feels soft and smooth.
Some consumers avoid leather products because they are concerned about animal welfare and the environmental impact of production.

tip: Thường không đếm được; trong leather jacket, danh từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ.

senses.en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.
To transport goods by truck.

ex.en: A truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.

col: truck goods｜chở hàng bằng xe tải
tip: truck thường dùng trong tiếng Anh Mỹ; tiếng Anh Anh hay dùng lorry.

senses.en: an electrical appliance that heats bread until crisp and brown

ex.en: Two slices of bread popped out of the toaster.
Small appliances such as toasters should be designed for easy repair rather than frequent replacement.

col: put bread in the toaster｜cho bánh mì vào máy nướng
tip: toaster là thiết bị điện; toast chỉ bánh mì nướng và không đếm được.

senses.en: A thick, slightly sour food made by fermenting milk.

ex.en: I mix fresh berries into my yogurt every morning.
Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.

col: a pot of yogurt｜một hũ sữa chua
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh cũng hay viết yoghurt; thường không đếm được, một phần ăn có thể nói a yogurt.

senses.en: having happened or started a short time ago

ex.en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.

col: recent developments｜những diễn biến gần đây
in recent years｜trong những năm gần đây
tip: recent là tính từ; bổ nghĩa cho hành động thì dùng recently.

senses.zh: bánh mì kẹp thịt; miếng thịt xay nướng
senses.en: A flat food patty, often served inside a round bread roll

ex.en: I ordered a bean burger with salad for lunch.
Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.

col: beef burger｜bánh mì kẹp thịt bò
tip: burger cũng có thể chỉ riêng miếng thịt, và không phải lúc nào cũng làm từ thịt bò.

senses.en: Closest in distance, time, or similarity
At the shortest distance from someone or something

ex.en: Could you show me the way to the nearest pharmacy?
For many rural residents, the nearest hospital is several hours away, making access to emergency care difficult.

col: nearest neighbour｜người hàng xóm gần nhất
nearest available｜cái gần nhất có sẵn
to the nearest kilometre｜làm tròn đến ki-lô-mét gần nhất
tip: Là dạng so sánh nhất của near; khi làm định ngữ thường dùng the nearest.

senses.en: a piece of wax with a central string that burns

ex.en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.

col: blow out a candle｜thổi tắt nến
tip: Thắp nến dùng light; thổi tắt dùng blow out.

senses.en: the way a person or animal acts

senses.zh: đặc tính hoạt động; cách phản ứng
senses.en: the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions

ex.en: The puppy's calm behavior surprised everyone at the park.
Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.

col: consumer behavior｜hành vi người tiêu dùng
animal behavior｜hành vi của động vật
patterns of behavior｜các kiểu hành vi
tip: Đây là cách viết kiểu Mỹ; kiểu Anh là behaviour. Thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.

ex.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.

col: factory production｜sản xuất tại nhà máy
tip: Số nhiều là factories; chỉ nơi sản xuất hàng hóa.

senses.en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use.
Not busy and able to meet or help someone.

ex.en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.

col: available to everyone｜dành cho mọi người
available for use｜có thể sử dụng
make something available｜làm cho ai cũng có thể dùng
tip: available to đi với người dùng; available for đi với mục đích.

senses.en: To want something, especially something unlikely or not currently true.
A strong desire for something to happen or be true.
To express hope for someone's happiness or success.

ex.en: I wish our flat had a bigger kitchen.
Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.

col: wish someone luck｜chúc ai may mắn
best wishes｜lời chúc tốt đẹp nhất
wish to do something｜mong muốn làm việc gì
tip: Sau wish dùng quá khứ để nói tiếc nuối ở hiện tại; dùng quá khứ hoàn thành để nói tiếc nuối về quá khứ.

senses.en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.

ex.en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
Buying second-hand furniture can lower household expenses while reducing demand for raw materials and limiting waste.

col: a piece of furniture｜một món đồ nội thất
wooden furniture｜đồ nội thất bằng gỗ
tip: Không đếm được: “một món nội thất” nói là a piece of furniture.

senses.en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems

senses.zh: tăng lên; đứng dậy (quá khứ của rise)
senses.en: past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased

ex.en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.

col: a bunch of roses｜một bó hoa hồng
tip: rose cũng là quá khứ của rise; quá khứ phân từ là risen.

senses.en: A small control you press to operate something
A small object that fastens clothing through a hole
Fasten clothing using buttons

ex.en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.

col: button up a coat｜cài cúc áo khoác
sew on a button｜khâu cúc áo
tip: button up nghĩa là cài cúc; kéo khóa kéo dùng zip, không dùng button.

senses.en: A Christian festival celebrating Jesus Christ's return to life.

ex.en: We decorated eggs together at the kitchen table for Easter.
During Easter, many destinations attract additional visitors through seasonal events, creating temporary employment in the tourism sector.

col: the Easter holidays｜kỳ nghỉ lễ Phục sinh
tip: Tên ngày lễ viết hoa chữ cái đầu; at Easter nghĩa là vào dịp lễ Phục sinh.
note: Tên ngày lễ đã được viết hoa chữ cái đầu.

senses.en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.

ex.en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.

tip: Chữ s không phát âm; trên đảo dùng on an island.
